name: AG Semiconductor Services, LLC.
old_description: AG Semiconductor Services (AGSS) offers remarketing services converting surplus 150mm to 300mm manufacturing equipment into cash, quickly and efficiently. Since 1999, our team of experts has sold more than 16,000 assets (including individual tools and entire fabs or fab lines) to more than 500 different customers in 24 countries.
about:
AG Semiconductor Services (AGSS) is headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut. The company was founded in 1999 and has grown into a major supplier of used semiconductor manufacturing equipment. No founders are named in public materials, and ownership details are not disclosed.

AGSS provides remarketing services that convert surplus 150mm to 300mm manufacturing equipment into cash, handling everything from individual tools to entire fab lines. Its service portfolio includes equipment acquisition, de‑installation, decontamination, refurbishment (performed in‑house or by qualified third parties), installation, rigging, crating, transport, project management, and warranty support. The company reports having sold more than 16,000 assets to over 500 customers in 24 countries, and operates cleanroom and warehousing facilities to support refurbishment and storage.

The customer base spans well‑established and early‑stage semiconductor companies, integrated device manufacturers (IDMs), and original equipment manufacturers (OEMs). AGSS sources most of its inventory from major fab closures and leading electronics manufacturers worldwide, and its sales range from single tools to complete manufacturing lines for front‑end semiconductor processing, IC test/assembly, and printed circuit board assembly.

AGSS emphasizes quality, flexibility, and availability as core drivers of its growth. Its project managers come from IDM fab backgrounds, bringing hands‑on experience with industry best‑known methods, and the company offers turnkey solutions that cover the full lifecycle from tool selection and configuration through acceptance and ongoing support.
